    Career

    Progress saves in this browser only. The online page and a downloaded copy keep separate saves, so use Export and Import to move your rank, stats and settings between them.

    Controls

    W A S DMove
    MouseLook
    Left clickFire · knife slash
    Right clickAim down sights · knife stab
    ShiftSprint
    C CtrlCrouch
    SpaceJump (vault crates and sandbags)
    RReload
    1 2 3 4Weapon slots. Classic: primary · sidearm · knife. Two-Gun: gun · gun · knife. Overkill: three guns, knife on 4
    Wheel QCycle weapons · last weapon
    GFrag grenade, hold to cook
    FDeploy killstreak
    TabScoreboard
    BWeapon menu (Sandbox)
    EPick up a dropped weapon
    EscPause

    These are the defaults. Change any key in Settings. Arrow keys also turn the camera.

    Killstreaks: 3 kills earns a Recon UAV, 5 a mortar strike, 7 a sentry gun. Knife an enemy from behind for an instant kill.
